marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to west 10 to 15 knots this afternoon and
to west 15 to 20 this evening. Wind diminishing to west 10 to 15 early Friday
morning then veering to north 15 late Friday morning. Snow beginning near noon with a risk of freezing rain early
this afternoon changing to flurries this evening and ending Friday morning. Fog
banks dissipating late this afternoon. Temperatures plus 3 falling to minus 3 Friday
evening. <br/>
